name: Chemistry of Materials for Energy Conversion
description: The course comprises starts with basic introduction to renewable energy conversion and introduces the required electrochemical and electronic structure components of materials. Specific applications including electrocatalysis, photochemistry, photovoltaics, batteries, supercapacitors and thermoelectric devices are covered in this course.
